defs.def: a person who does a job without being paid for it 义务工作者；志愿者

ex.s: We welcome volunteers to help transform reclaimed materials into objects with new and creative purposes.
ex.t: 我们欢迎志愿者帮忙将回收材料改造成具有崭新而富有创意用途的物品。

ex.s: Creative Workshops: learn basic repairs and artistic redesign of old furniture, while sharing knowledge and ideas with fellow volunteers,
ex.t: 社会与环境行动：通过创造力和合作帮助应对社会和环境挑战。

ex.s: What can volunteers do?
ex.t: 志愿者可以做什么？

ex.s: Unexpected Benefits of Volunteering as a Family
ex.t: 以家庭为单位做志愿服务的意外好处

ex.s: People often feel they are too busy to volunteer.
ex.t: 人们常觉得自己太忙而无法做志愿者。

ex.s: ●You can live longer if you volunteer regularly.
ex.t: 如果你定期做志愿者，你可以活得更长。

ex.s: Volunteering during teenage years has been linked to some major positive effects such as improved grades and increased self-confidence.
ex.t: 希望能给一些有才华的演员留下印象，让他们愿意免费为我工作，我在沙发上铺了一些毯子，点上蜡烛，让它看起来更像"年轻专业人士"的风格。

ex.s: Volunteering has a lifelong effect on kids and teenagers.
ex.t: 志愿服务对孩子和青少年有一生的影响。

ex.s: Volunteering can be the first step in breaking down prejudice.
ex.t: 志愿服务可以是消除偏见的第一步。

ex.s: For adults, volunteering can provide significant physical health benefits.
ex.t: 对成年人来说，志愿服务能带来显著的身体健康益处。

ex.s: Volunteering makes you feel capable and inspires you to make the most of each day.
ex.t: 志愿服务让你感到自己有能力，并激励你充分利用每一天。

ex.s: Volunteer in a science lab.
ex.t: 在科学实验室做志愿者。

ex.s: Habitat Restoration Team volunteers play a vital role in restoring sensitive resources and protecting endangered species across the ridges and valleys.
ex.t: 栖息地修复团队的志愿者在恢复敏感资源、保护山脊与山谷间的濒危物种方面发挥着重要作用。

ex.s: Volunteers aged 10 and over are welcome.
ex.t: 欢迎10岁及以上的志愿者参加。

ex.s: Bring your completed Volunteer Agreement Form.
ex.t: 请携带填写完整的志愿者协议表。

ex.s: Volunteers under the age of 18 must have the parent/guardian approval section signed.
ex.t: 未满18岁的志愿者必须由家长/监护人签字批准。

ex.s: What are the volunteers expected to do?
ex.t: 志愿者需要做什么？

ex.s: Volunteers will wash, cut, and freeze or dry them for use in meals down the road.
ex.t: 志愿者们会将它们清洗、切块、冷冻或干燥，以便日后用于餐食中。

ex.s: Levine and his research team selected volunteers aged between 45 and 64 who did not exercise much but were otherwise healthy.
ex.t: Levine和他的研究团队选择了45至64岁之间不常运动但其他方面健康的志愿者。

ex.s: Made of 168,000 plastic straws collected from several volunteer beach cleanups, the sculpture made its first appearance at the Estella Place shopping center in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam.
ex.t: 由从几次志愿者海滩清理中收集的168,000根塑料吸管制成，这座雕塑首次亮相于越南胡志明市的Estella Place购物中心。

ex.s: become OIC volunteersB. further their education
ex.t: 成为OIC志愿者 B. 继续接受教育

ex.s: In the mid-1990s, Tom Bissell taught English as a volunteer in Uzbekistan.
ex.t: 20世纪90年代中期，汤姆·比斯尔作为志愿者在乌兹别克斯坦教英语。

ex.s: Working as a volunteer in Uzbekistan.
ex.t: 在乌兹别克斯坦做志愿者。

ex.s: Researchers from the University of Leipzig in Germany gathered more than 1, 000 retired workers who were over age 75 and assessed the volunteers’ memory and thinking skills through a battery of tests.
ex.t: 德国莱比锡大学的研究人员召集了1000多名75岁以上的退休工人，通过一系列测试评估志愿者的记忆力和思维能力。

ex.s: Why did the scientists ask the volunteers to take the tests?
ex.t: 科学家为什么让志愿者参加测试？

ex.s: In a study describing the technology, the researchers had 100 volunteers type the word “touch”four times using the smart keyboard.
ex.t: 在一项描述该技术的研究中，研究人员让100名志愿者用智能键盘把“touch”这个词打了四遍。

ex.s: I’m secretly relieved because I know there’s real power in sharing volunteer responsibilities among many.
ex.t: 我暗自松了一口气，因为我知道在多人之间分担志愿责任是真正有力量的。

ex.s: Still, most of us volunteers breathe a sigh of relief when the season comes to a close.
ex.t: 尽管如此，当我们大多数志愿者在赛季结束时都会松一口气。

ex.s: Volunteering just feels so good.
ex.t: 志愿服务的感觉真好。

ex.s: In that sense, I’m pretty sure volunteering is more of a selfish act than I’d freely like to admit.
ex.t: 从这个意义上说，我很确定志愿服务比我愿意承认的更像是一种自私的行为。

ex.s: Why does the author like doing volunteer work?
ex.t: 作者为什么喜欢做志愿工作？

ex.s: We work with volunteers of all ages and backgrounds.
ex.t: 我们与各种年龄和背景的志愿者合作。

ex.s: Most of our volunteers are aged 17-24.Now we need volunteer managers aged 25-75.They are extremely important in the safe and effective running of our programmes.
ex.t: 我们的大多数志愿者年龄在17-24岁。现在我们需要25-75岁的志愿者经理。他们对我们计划的安全和有效运行极其重要。

ex.s: You might also design an adventure challenge to train young volunteers.
ex.t: 我们的志愿者大多年龄在17-24岁之间。现在我们需要年龄在25-75岁之间的志愿者管理者。他们对于我们项目的安全有效运行非常重要。

ex.s: Not only will you help our young volunteers to develop personally，you'll also learn new skills and increase your cultural awareness.
ex.t: 你不仅能帮助我们年轻的志愿者在个人方面成长，还能学到新技能并提高你的文化意识。

ex.s: GDA ensures that volunteers work with community members and local project partners where our help is needed.
ex.t: GDA确保志愿者在需要我们帮助的地方与社区成员和当地项目合作伙伴一起工作。

ex.s: What is the main responsibility of volunteer managers?
ex.t: 志愿者管理者的主要职责是什么？

ex.s: Membership in sports or social club and participation as a volunteer are good examples of this.
ex.t: 加入体育或社团俱乐部、以志愿者身份参与，都是这方面的好例子。

ex.s: I work with Volunteers for Wildlife, a rescue and education organization at Bailey Arboretum in Locust Valley.
ex.t: 我在“野生动物志愿者”——一家位于洛克斯特谷贝利植物园的救援与教育组织——工作。

ex.s: School staff and student volunteers will show new students around the school, and "the new students will get their schedules and find out where their classrooms are".
ex.t: 学校工作人员和学生志愿者将向学校周围的新生展示， “新生将得到他们的时间表，并找出他们的教室在哪里”。

ex.s: Most of the organisers are volunteers and much of the money raised from ticket sales goes to charity.
ex.t: 大多数组织者都是志愿者，门票销售筹集的大部分资金都捐给了慈善机构。

ex.s: On most UK high streets, for example, you will often come across people raising money and looking for volunteers for Cancer Research UK, the British Heart Foundation, the Royal National Lifeboat Institution and many more.
ex.t: 例如，在英国大多数商业街上，你常会遇到为英国癌症研究中心、英国心脏基金会、皇家全国救生艇协会等机构募款和招募志愿者的人。

ex.s: In China, volunteers are also playing an increasingly important role in environmental protection, disability assistance and many other fields.
ex.t: 在中国，志愿者在环境保护、残疾人援助和许多其他领域也发挥着越来越重要的作用。

ex.s: Join us as a volunteer manager to develop your own skills while bringing benefits to the communities.
ex.t: 加入我们成为志愿者经理，在为他人带来益处的同时发展自己的技能。

ex.s: Volunteering as a family may be just the thing you need.
ex.t: 全家一起做志愿服务，也许正是你所需要的。

ex.s: She just doesn't want to volunteer.
ex.t: 她只是不想做志愿者。

defs.def: a person who offers to do sth without being forced to do it 自告奋勇者；主动做某事的人
a person who chooses to join the armed forces without being forced to join 志愿兵；义勇兵
to offer to do sth without being forced to do it or without getting paid for it 自愿做；义务做；无偿做

ex.s: Cruse now volunteers to help kindergarten students with reading two days a week, and on a third day, he instructs the school's first-and second-graders.
ex.t: 克鲁斯现在每周自愿花两天帮助幼儿园孩子阅读，第三天则指导学校的一、二年级学生。

ex.s: Many people donate money and others volunteer to help run charities.
ex.t: 许多人捐款，另一些人则自愿帮助运营慈善机构。

defs.def: to suggest sth or tell sb sth without being asked 主动建议（或告诉）
to join the army, etc. without being forced to 自愿参军；当志愿兵
to suggest sb for a job or an activity, even though they may not want to do it （未经当事人同意）举荐
